indicator_name: Kazakhstan balance of payments (IMF BOP, BPM6), all standard components, quarterly
description: Платёжный баланс Казахстана (МВФ, РПБ6), все стандартные компоненты, поквартально
methodology: Item = accounting entry . indicator: CD_T credit, DB_T debit, NETCD_T net (credit less debit), A_NFA_T net acquisition of financial assets, L_NIL_T net incurrence of liabilities, NNAFANIL_T net (assets less liabilities), A_T reserve assets. 1995Q1 onward (most detail from 2005). NETCD_T.CAB equals NBK CURRENT_ACCOUNT_BALANCE.
